spec.description: Open live control websocket sessions, derived from the hub lifetimes themselves.
spec.title: Live Control Sessions by Gateway

spec.description: Connect attempts by outcome against teardowns. A flat connection gauge can still hide hubs flapping.
spec.title: Hub Connection Churn

spec.description: Clients trying to open a live control session. hub_not_found means the hub is not on this gateway.
spec.title: Live Control Session Attempts

spec.description: Client round trip from the ping/pong exchange. Quantiles are computed from the histogram at query time.
spec.title: Live Control Client Latency

spec.description: Frames processed, counted per frame - a bulk frame counts once per frame it carries.
spec.title: Live Control Frames by Outcome

spec.description: Share of frames not handed to the hub. A jump means clients are sending frames they are not allowed to.
spec.title: Live Control Frame Rejection Rate

spec.description: Shocker control requests by source and outcome. A request is rejected on its first bad shocker.
spec.title: Control Requests

spec.description: Distinct shockers commanded by one successful control request - how wide a single command spreads.
spec.title: Control Fan-out (shockers per request)

spec.description: Shock commands dispatched over the selected time range. Counts commands, not requests - one request can carry several shockers.
spec.title: Shocks

spec.description: Individual shocker commands dispatched from the API, by control type.
spec.title: Control Commands by Type

spec.description: Accepted live control frames by type. These are ticks of a held control at the hub's tick rate, NOT discrete presses - do not add them to the API command counts.
spec.title: Live Control Frames by Type

spec.expr: {organization.name=~"$org", environment.name=~"$env", service.name=~"$service"} | SourceContext: "Serilog.AspNetCore.RequestLoggingMiddleware" | stats by (StatusCode) count() requests
